process_openai_embedding_input: process OpenAI-style embedding input into Vertex AI multimodal instances supporting text, images, and videos
transform_embedding_request: transform OpenAI embedding request into Vertex AI multimodal embedding request format
transform_embedding_response: transform Vertex AI multimodal embedding response back to OpenAI embedding response format
transform_embedding_response_to_openai: transform Vertex AI multimodal predictions into OpenAI Embedding objects
map_openai_params: map OpenAI embedding parameters like dimensions to Vertex AI parameter names
